subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this experimental core Claws status/remove contract, including persisted ownership authority to delete managed files and uninstall final-reference packages?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but adopting a destructive core CLI and durable recovery model is a product and ownership decision spanning an open RFC and multiple unmerged prerequisite PRs.

options.title: Sponsor the stacked contract
options.body: Review the RFC and prerequisite provenance slices together, require live upgrade and recovery proof, then merge this removal slice in stack order.

options.title: Land read-only status only
options.body: Keep lifecycle visibility while deferring removal and package uninstall until maintainers approve the destructive ownership contract.

options.title: Pause the Claws stack
options.body: Leave the drafts unmerged until maintainers select a different packaging, ownership, or recovery direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the stacked contract
recommendation.body: Review the RFC and prerequisite provenance slices together, require live upgrade and recovery proof, then merge this removal slice in stack order.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the active assignee and already supplied the ownership requirement that drove the latest implementation.
